transcript:
Where can I find the return desk?
(A) It's next to the main entrance.
(B) Yes, I returned it yesterday.
(C) About fifteen minutes.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Where' (ở đâu) → chỉ vị trí 'next to the main entrance' (A). (B) lặp từ 'return' và trả lời Yes cho câu Wh-, (C) nói thời gian.

transcript:
When does the hotel restaurant open for breakfast?
(A) The buffet was delicious.
(B) At six thirty every morning.
(C) On the second floor.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'When' (khi nào) → giờ mở cửa 'At six thirty every morning' (B). (A) nói về món ăn, (C) nói địa điểm.

transcript:
Who's in charge of the holiday window display?
(A) Melissa from the design team.
(B) Yes, it looks great.
(C) Until the end of December.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Who' (ai phụ trách) → 'Melissa from the design team' (A). (B) trả lời Yes cho câu Wh-, (C) nói thời gian.

transcript:
Why was the flight to Denver delayed?
(A) Gate twelve, I think.
(B) There's a problem with the weather.
(C) I'll fly there next week.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Why' (tại sao) → lý do 'a problem with the weather' (B). (A) nói cổng ra máy bay, (C) lặp từ 'fly'.

transcript:
How much does it cost to upgrade to a suite?
(A) The front desk can give you the rates.
(B) A wonderful view of the bay.
(C) For three nights.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'How much' (giá bao nhiêu) → trả lời gián tiếp: 'The front desk can give you the rates' (A). (B) nói về cảnh, (C) nói số đêm.

transcript:
What time should we leave for the airport?
(A) Terminal B.
(B) A taxi, probably.
(C) Our flight boards at four, so around one.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'What time' (mấy giờ) → 'around one' kèm lý do giờ lên máy bay (C). (A) nói nhà ga, (B) nói phương tiện.

transcript:
Which size would you like to try on?
(A) Do you have it in a medium?
(B) It fits in my bag.
(C) The fitting rooms are busy.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Which size' → khách hỏi lại có cỡ medium không, ngầm chọn cỡ M (A). (B) lặp ý 'fit', (C) lặp 'fitting/try on' nhưng không trả lời.

transcript:
Has the new shipment of shoes arrived?
(A) Yes, a pair of running shoes.
(B) The truck is running late today.
(C) At the shipping counter.

questions.explanation: Câu Yes/No hỏi hàng đã về chưa → trả lời gián tiếp 'The truck is running late' = chưa về (B). (A) lặp từ 'shoes', (C) gần âm 'shipping'.

transcript:
Didn't you book a table for six people?
(A) I booked it for eight, actually.
(B) A nice table by the window.
(C) At six o'clock.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định → 'I booked it for eight, actually' (thực ra đặt cho 8 người) (A). (B) lặp 'table', (C) lặp 'six' nhưng là giờ.

transcript:
The customer survey results are ready, aren't they?
(A) I'll survey the customers.
(B) Mr. Kato is reviewing them now.
(C) They're ready to order.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi về kết quả khảo sát → 'Mr. Kato is reviewing them now' (đang xem, gần như sẵn sàng) (B). (A) lặp 'survey', (C) lặp 'ready'.

transcript:
Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
(A) Whichever is closer to the front.
(B) Yes, I would.
(C) The seat belt sign is on.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → 'Whichever is closer to the front' (chỗ nào gần phía trước cũng được) (A). (B) trả lời Yes cho câu lựa chọn, (C) lặp 'seat'.

transcript:
Should we pay by credit card or ask the hotel to send an invoice?
(A) The company prefers invoices.
(B) A pay raise next month.
(C) Sure, I'll send it to you.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn hai cách thanh toán → 'The company prefers invoices' (A). (B) gần âm 'pay', (C) lặp 'send' nhưng không chọn.

transcript:
Could you help me carry these boxes to the stockroom?
(A) They're in stock.
(B) Sure, just give me a minute.
(C) Yes, a large box.

questions.explanation: Lời nhờ giúp → đồng ý 'Sure, just give me a minute' (B). (A) gần âm 'stock', (C) lặp 'box'.

transcript:
Why don't we offer customers a free gift with every purchase?
(A) That might be too expensive.
(B) Because it was free.
(C) I purchased it online.

questions.explanation: 'Why don't we…' là lời đề nghị → phản hồi về đề nghị: 'That might be too expensive' (A). (B) hiểu nhầm là câu hỏi lý do, (C) lặp 'purchase'.

transcript:
The shuttle bus to the convention center leaves every twenty minutes.
(A) Then we can still catch the next one.
(B) Twenty conference rooms.
(C) No, he left yesterday.

questions.explanation: Câu trần thuật về lịch xe đưa đón → phản hồi hợp lý 'Then we can still catch the next one' (A). (B) lặp 'twenty', (C) lặp 'left'.
